'''''Green/Aura''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]], and, alongside the IPV-1 ''[[Green/Besh]]'' and the [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] [[Rage (Lancer-class)|''Rage'']], was stationed<ref name="Orbit" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> at the Imperial [[Bavos-II heavy-duty military space platform|Bavos-II military space platform]] [[Station 1B6/Green]] on the edge of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds's]] [[Ringali Nebula/Legends|Ringali Nebula]]. As an IPV-1<ref name="Orbit" /> measuring 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and produced by the [[Company/Legends|company]] [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]],<ref name="Stele" /> the ''Green/Aura'' could reach a speed of one thousand [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], was armed with four [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], and acted as an inter-[[Star system/Legends|system]] patrol and customs [[Starship/Legends|craft]].<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Green/Aura'' was first mentioned in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the privateering [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''. Players could attack Station 1B6/Green with the ''Far Orbit'' as a part of the scenerio hook "Who Is The More Foolish&hellip;?". If they did, the ''Green/Aura'' would most likely defend the station.<ref name="Orbit" />
